_comment: Lines Fiona MacLeod, the Lord Admiral, speaks aloud. Generated to public/assets/audio/voice/<id>.ogg|m4a by scripts/build_voice.py. Keep each line short: she speaks only at important moments.
welcome: Majesty. I'm Fiona MacLeod, your Lord Admiral. You've one wee planet, a few ships, and a great deal of empty sky. Let's change that.
clock: Nothing moves until you start the clock. Stop it whenever you need to think.
grow: Every star out there is a place we could own. First we look, then we claim.
pretender: There's a pretender out there, sitting on a world and calling himself king. Small fleet, big mouth. He'll be your first lesson in war.
conquest: Taking a planet is a recipe. Warships, soldiers, a declaration, a fight in the sky, and a landing.
declare: War it is. From now on, they shoot back.
orbit: The sky is ours. Send the soldiers down.
captured: The planet is ours! Well done, Majesty.
peace: Peace is signed. Wars cost coin, and a wise ruler knows when to stop.
quest_borders: Good. Now mark our borders. Three star systems, Majesty.
quest_find: Our borders are set. Now send the scout to find the pretender's world.
quest_fleet: Found him. Now build a fleet strong enough to break his guard, and soldiers to land.
quest_crown: The fleet is ready. Declare war, take his world, and take back your crown.
prologue_done: The pretender is finished, and the great realms have noticed you. Mind yourself. From here on, the real game begins.
war_on_you: Majesty, they've declared war on us! Build warships and keep them close to home.
enemy_in_space: Enemy ships inside our borders! Send the fleet, or they'll take a world from us.
first_battle: Our ships are fighting. They'll manage on their own. Watch, and pull them back if it goes badly.
peace_offer: They're asking for peace. Accept it, or make them sweat a wee while longer.
first_contact: We're not alone out here. Neighbours. Let's keep an eye on them.
shortage: We've run dry of something. Fix it before it starts to hurt.
rival_arming: A rival is building ships aimed at us. We've time, but not much.
planet_lost: We've lost a world, Majesty. We take it back, or we learn from it.
rival_near_win: A rival is close to winning the galaxy. If they hold on, we lose. Stop them.
near_win: Victory is in sight, Majesty. Hold steady, and the galaxy is yours.
